name: Lanternwood Grove of Unspoken Wishes
description: A grove of twisted trees whose bark bears glowing lanterns, each holding a captured wish that floats gently in the night air.
prompt: A mystical Lanternwood Grove of gnarled trees adorned with warm glowing lanterns suspended in the air, each lantern containing a floating wish, soft mist surrounding, painterly, whimsical, no text.
caption: Leave a wish in the Lanternwood Grove – the lanterns guard your dreams until they find their way.
